description: This file defines a utility/factory class 'LoanChargeRequestFactory' that provides static methods to create pre-configured request objects for loan charge operations in the Fineract project. It specifies default request parameters and methods to generate request objects for different loan charge scenarios.

classes.name: LoanChargeRequestFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods to generate loan charge request objects with default parameters.

methods.name: defaultLoanChargeRequest
methods.description: Creates a default loan charge request with preset charge ID, amount, locale, and date format.

methods.name: defaultLoanChargeWaiveRequest
methods.description: Creates a request to waive a loan charge, setting the date format, locale, and transaction date.
